list.title: What is the Use of Underarm Roll-on?
list.content: Underarm roll-on is a personal care product that controls body odour and keeps underarms clean and fresh. The 4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On for Women is specifically designed to provide freedom from smelly underarms with pigmentation. It helps mask the odour, keeps underarms clean and healthy, and reduces pigmentation over time.

list.title: Does Roll-on Lighten Underarms?
list.content: Yes, roll-ons can help to lighten underarms. The 4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On for Women, for example, is specifically designed to reduce pigmentation over time. The product contains 2% Lactic Acid, which exfoliates dead skin cells and helps to fade pigmentation. Additionally, the 1% Mandelic Acid and Alpha Arbutin in the roll-on seep under the skin and slow down melanin production from within, which can also help to lighten underarms.

list.title: Does Underarm Roll-on Stop Sweat?
list.content: Underarm roll-ons are not designed to stop sweating completely. However, they can help to control sweating and reduce excessive perspiration. The 1% Salicylic Acid in the 4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On for Women helps to kill sweat-causing bacteria, which can help to mask odour and keep underarms fresh. The roll-on also contains ingredients such as Shea Butter and Aloe Vera, which help to soothe and moisturise the skin, making it less prone to irritation and sweating.

list.title: What Are the Side Effects of Roll-on?
list.content: The 4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On for Women is made with gentle and safe ingredients that are unlikely to cause any side effects when used as directed. It is free from harsh chemicals, fragrances, and alcohol, which are common irritants that can cause skin dryness, itching, and redness. The roll-on is formulated to be non-sticky and non-greasy, which makes it comfortable to wear throughout the day.

list.title: What is the Use of Underarm Roll-on for Ladies?
list.content: Ladies' underarm roll-ons are intended to provide long-lasting sweat and odour protection while also improving the overall health and appearance of the underarms. For example, the 4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On for Women contains a blend of ingredients like Salicylic Acid, Lactic Acid, Mandelic Acid, and Alpha Arbutin, which help to exfoliate dead skin cells, reduce pigmentation, and slow down melanin production from within.  Furthermore, moisturising ingredients like Shea Butter and Aloe Vera help to soothe and nourish the skin, making it less prone to irritation and discomfort. Underarm roll-ons can help to control excessive sweating, mask odour, and promote healthy, even-toned underarms when used regularly.

list.title: Can We Apply Roll-on After Shaving Underarms?
list.content: Applying underarm roll-on after shaving is generally safe, but it is important to wait a few minutes after shaving to allow the skin to heal and avoid irritation. Shaving can cause small cuts and abrasions on the skin, increasing the risk of irritation and infection. Applying a roll-on immediately after shaving can also cause stinging or burning sensations, as the skin is more sensitive. To avoid irritation and discomfort, it is recommended to wait at least 10-15 minutes after shaving before applying an underarm roll-on.

list.title: When is the best time to apply a roll-on for results?
list.content: Roll-ons work best on clean, completely dry skin, usually right after a shower. Let it absorb for 30-60 seconds before wearing clothes. Avoid applying immediately after shaving or waxing, as your skin may be too sensitive. BeBodywise Underarm Roll On is quick-drying and lightweight, making it easy to use daily as part of your morning routine for all-day freshness and gradual skin brightening.

list.title: How long does freshness last with BeBodywise Roll On in hot weather?
list.content: In normal conditions, BeBodywise Roll On keeps you fresh for up to 12 hours by targeting odour-causing bacteria. In very humid climates or during workouts, you may want to reapply, but the formula is lightweight and dries quickly, making reapplication easy and comfortable.

list.title: Does BeBodywise Roll On reduce sweating or just odour?
list.content: BeBodywise is a deodorant and brightening roll-on, it doesn’t block sweat glands since it’s aluminium-free. Instead, it neutralises bacteria so even if you sweat, you won’t smell. This makes it safer for long-term use and better for people who want odour control without interfering with the body’s natural cooling.

list.title: Is BeBodywise Roll On safe for teenagers and sensitive skin?
list.content: Absolutely. BeBodywise Roll On is dermatologist-tested, aluminium- and alcohol-free, and available in a fragrance-free variant for very sensitive users. Designed for women, but safe even for teenagers starting early with odour concerns. Adults with sensitive skin should patch-test before applying underarms. It’s designed to be safe yet effective for all skin types.

list.title: What’s this product for? What do you mean by dual exfoliation?
list.content: This advanced body wash provides dual exfoliation. It uses natural perlite beads (derived from volcanic ash) and encapsulated salicylic acid beads for gentle physical exfoliation, buffing away dead skin cells. The AHA/BHA combination (glycolic and lactic acid/salicylic acid) provides deeper chemical exfoliation, unclogs pores, reduces the appearance of "strawberry skin" and bumps, and promotes cell turnover. Lactic acid also adds a hydrating benefit.

list.title: I am new to exfoliation; what should I know about this product?
list.content: Exfoliation is the way to smoother skin! This body wash uses both AHAs (glycolic and lactic acid) and BHAs (salicylic acid) for gentle exfoliation. If you're new to exfoliating, start by using it 2-3 times a week and gradually increase to daily use as your skin adjusts. Discontinue use if you experience any irritation.

list.title: Why do I need to use SPF after any AHA-BHA products?
list.content: AHAs and BHAs, while incredibly effective can also make your skin more sensitive to the sun. Using a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of 30 or higher every day is crucial to protect your skin from sun damage. Think of it as protecting your newly revealed, radiant skin!

list.title: Can I use this product on my face?
list.content: This product is formulated for use on the body and may be too potent for the delicate skin on your face. We recommend using products specifically designed for facial exfoliation.

list.title: Won't this product be harsh on my body? Can I use it everyday?
list.content: While this product contains powerful exfoliants, it's also formulated with nourishing ingredients like shea butter and oils to help soothe and moisturise the skin. However, everyone's skin is different. We recommend starting with 2-3 uses per week and gradually increasing to daily use as your skin tolerates it. If you experience any redness, dryness, or irritation, reduce usage or discontinue use.

list.title: How does it help with razor bumps and ingrown hair?
list.content: " The glycolic and lactic acids provide deep exfoliation, while salicylic acid (a BHA) helps prevent and treat ingrown hairs and razor bumps. Salicylic acid gently exfoliates the skin's surface and unclogs pores, allowing hairs to grow out properly and reducing redness, inflammation, and bumps. "

list.title: What are the benefits of this body wash?
list.content: This body wash is formulated to address rough, bumpy skin through dual exfoliation while also hydrating and nourishing. It's an excellent solution for body acne, tan reduction, and pigmentation concerns. While providing deep exfoliation, it's also designed to be hydrating and non-drying.

list.title: What’s this product for? What do you mean by dual exfoliation?
list.content: This advanced body wash provides dual exfoliation. It uses natural perlite beads (derived from volcanic ash) and encapsulated salicylic acid beads for gentle physical exfoliation, buffing away dead skin cells. The AHA/BHA combination (glycolic and lactic acid/salicylic acid) provides deeper chemical exfoliation, unclogs pores, reduces the appearance of "strawberry skin" and bumps, and promotes cell turnover. Lactic acid also adds a hydrating benefit.

list.title: I am new to exfoliation; what should I know about this product?
list.content: Exfoliation is the way to smoother skin! This body wash uses both AHAs (glycolic and lactic acid) and BHAs (salicylic acid) for gentle exfoliation. If you're new to exfoliating, start by using it 2-3 times a week and gradually increase to daily use as your skin adjusts. Discontinue use if you experience any irritation.

list.title: Why do I need to use SPF after any AHA-BHA products?
list.content: AHAs and BHAs, while incredibly effective can also make your skin more sensitive to the sun. Using a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of 30 or higher every day is crucial to protect your skin from sun damage. Think of it as protecting your newly revealed, radiant skin!

list.title: Can I use this product on my face?
list.content: This product is formulated for use on the body and may be too potent for the delicate skin on your face. We recommend using products specifically designed for facial exfoliation.

list.title: Won't this product be harsh on my body? Can I use it everyday?
list.content: While this product contains powerful exfoliants, it's also formulated with nourishing ingredients like shea butter and oils to help soothe and moisturise the skin. However, everyone's skin is different. We recommend starting with 2-3 uses per week and gradually increasing to daily use as your skin tolerates it. If you experience any redness, dryness, or irritation, reduce usage or discontinue use.

list.title: How does it help with razor bumps and ingrown hair?
list.content: " The glycolic and lactic acids provide deep exfoliation, while salicylic acid (a BHA) helps prevent and treat ingrown hairs and razor bumps. Salicylic acid gently exfoliates the skin's surface and unclogs pores, allowing hairs to grow out properly and reducing redness, inflammation, and bumps. "

list.title: What are the benefits of this body wash?
list.content: This body wash is formulated to address rough, bumpy skin through dual exfoliation while also hydrating and nourishing. It's an excellent solution for body acne, tan reduction, and pigmentation concerns. While providing deep exfoliation, it's also designed to be hydrating and non-drying.

list.title: What is Biotin?

These natural actives for hair growth are often considered the best alternative to hair transplants due to their all-natural and non-hormonal hair regrowth qualities.

list.title: Is face razor good for face for women?
list.content: Shaving your face is beneficial. Regular use leads to smoother and soft skin. It also mildly exfoliates giving your skincare products a better chance to work

list.title: Does face razor increase hair growth?
list.content: No hair removal method causes thicker or darker growth, including shaving. Hair growth depends on your follicle health. Shaving gives you a blunt tip, i.e. when it grows back, it has a sharper tip but it doesn't change hair growth

list.title: Will shaving upper lip make it darker?
list.content: Shaving does not make the skin darker. It is just a hair removal method. Unlike some depilatory creams that  can darken the appearance of skin over time - shaving simply does not cause dark skin

list.title: Is razor good for facial hair removal?
list.content: Your facial skin is very delicate compared to your body. Threading or waxing might give you hair-free skin for a longer period but the pulling and tension can be harmful. Particularly for sensitive skin- other methods often cause itching and discomfort were as shaving does not.

list.title: How often should a woman shave her face?
list.content: Women should shave their faces according to their growth. Some women have a lesser growth, making it okay to shave once in two weeks, while others need to shave once a week.

list.title: Should I wax or shave my face?
list.content: Short answer - it's up to you. Both methods have merits and demerits of their own but if you are looking for a painless and easy method for hair removal that also benefits your skin- shaving is the answer!

list.title: What to apply after shaving face?
list.content: Post shaving, your face would feel soft due to the exfoliation of dead skin cells. You should follow up with a thick moisturiser filled with antioxidants like (Vitamin E or Hyaluronic Acid). If you are someone with oily skin, you can also try Be Bodywise Oil Control Moisturiser.

list.title: Can I shave my female upper lip?
list.content: Yes - you can shave your upper lip without the fear of darkening and thick hair

list.title: Can I shave my face every day?
list.content: No, you probably won't need to and it's not recommended to shave face everyday. If you are looking ahead to achieve that complete hairless look, it is suggested that you wait for a day or two between the shaving.

list.title: Can we apply face pack after shaving face?
list.content: We suggest moisturising your skin first and waiting a few hours before applying a face mask.

list.title: What should you not do after shaving your face?
list.content: Here are the don'ts after shaving your face. </br>Do not forget to moisturise and protect your skin: As you shave, your skin sheds dead skin cells, which leave your skin vulnerable. Thus, protect your skin by adding a layer of moisturiser and sunscreen. </br>Avoid applying makeup directly: Don't apply makeup or alcohol-based products on freshly shaved skin.

list.title: Can I use a clay mask after shaving my face?
list.content: We suggest moisturising your skin first and waiting a few hours before applying a clay mask.

list.title: Can I put coconut oil on my face after shaving?
list.content: Coconut oil has good emollient qualities making it an apt moisturiser post-shaving. However, you are someone with oily or acne-prone skin, the comedogenic properties of coconut oil might not be suitable for your skin. We'd suggest using Be Bodywise Oil Control Moisturiser.

list.title: What is Acne Patch?
list.content: An acne patch, also known as a pimple patch or acne sticker, is a small, adhesive patch that is designed to be placed directly on top of a pimple. These patches are typically made of hydrocolloid, a gel-like substance capable of absorbing excess oil and pus from pimples. Acne patches are frequently used as a spot treatment for pimples, especially those that have already popped. They can be worn under makeup and throughout the day, making them a convenient and discreet way to treat pimples.

list.title: Should I Pop Pimple Before Pimple Patch?
list.content: No, It is not recommended to pop a pimple before using a pimple patch. Popping a pimple can increase the risk of infection, inflammation, and scarring and can also make it more difficult for the pimple patch to adhere to the skin.

list.title: Can We Apply Roll-on After Shaving Underarms?
list.content: Applying underarm roll-on after shaving is generally safe, but it is important to wait a few minutes after shaving to allow the skin to heal and avoid irritation. Shaving can cause small cuts and abrasions on the skin, increasing the risk of irritation and infection. Applying a roll-on immediately after shaving can also cause stinging or burning sensations, as the skin is more sensitive. To avoid irritation and discomfort, it is recommended to wait at least 10-15 minutes after shaving before applying an underarm roll-on.

list.title: Is it OK to drink water from a water softener?
list.content: We wouldn't recommend drinking water mixed with a water softener.

list.title: What are the pros and cons of a water softener?
list.content:
The pros of using a water softener:
1. It doesn't cause scalp buildup
2. Neutralises the water
3. Improves efficacy of hair products

There are no known cons of using a water softener for hair or skin health

list.title: Why is soft water slippery?
list.content: The chelating agents in the soft water bind with magnesium and calcium ions with sodium ions resulting in the soft water being loaded with salt. This is what makes the water feel slimy.

list.title: Why is hard water bad for you?
list.content: Hard Water disturbs the pH of your skin and hair, weakening it as a barrier against harmful bacteria and infections. The minerals in the hard water build a film-like layer on your scalp, causing buildup which leads to poor air health. It  also reduces product efficacy

list.title: Is distilled water the same as soft water?
list.content: Distilled water has all the minerals and impurities eliminated, while soft water binds with magnesium and calcium, removes it and replaces it with salt.

list.title: Do you need a water softener if you have hard water?
list.content: Yes. Hard Water disturbs the pH balance of your scalp, causing more problems; apart from that, it leads to a layer of calcium and magnesium which degrades product efficacy.

list.title: How do you convert hard water to soft water at home for bathing?
list.content: We would recommend mixing 25 ml of Bodywise Chelate Water Softener. Please wait for it to mix and then use the bathing water.

list.title: How can I stop my hair fall from hard water?
list.content: We would recommend mixing 25 ml of Bodywise Chelate Water Softener. Please wait for it to mix, and then use the bathing water.

list.title: Can hard water cause an itchy scalp?
list.content: Hard Water leads to a buildup on the scalp and can cause the scalp to itch.

list.title: Will hair grow back after hard water?
list.content: Losing hair due to hard water is a reversible condition. We'd suggest eliminating the use of hard water by mixing Bodywise Chelate Water Softener.

list.title: What is chelation water treatment?
list.content: Chelating water treatment is a process where chelating agents bind with ions that cause hardness. This results in hard water going soft.
